findings.title: The normal lease-reclaim sequence can create a successor while the stopped predecessor is still normatively unfinished
findings.requirement: Lease reclaim must have one unambiguous transaction order that preserves the stated invariant of at most one unfinished Attempt per node across all fences.
evidence: PLAN.md §13 defines the exact reclaim order as recording STOPPED plus quiescence/effect receipts and then creating the new attempt/lease/fence/outbox.
docs/state-transition-manifests.md A10 reaches STOPPED with cleanup pending and explicitly marks the Attempt 'not finished'.
A11 is the later STOPPED->CANCELLED edge requiring cleanup complete/no unresolved effect, and the normative finished predicate says STOPPED remains unfinished.
PLAN.md §§8.2 and 13 independently require at most one unfinished Attempt per node across all fences, but the exact reclaim sequence does not require A11 before successor creation.
reproduction: Start Attempt A and follow A07-A10 after a missed renewal; termination and effect receipts exist, but cleanup is pending, so A is STOPPED and unfinished.
Follow PLAN §13 step (5) and create successor Attempt B. B is also unfinished from CREATED onward.

A and B now violate the across-fences uniqueness invariant. If admission instead rejects B to preserve the invariant, the documented 'exact reclaim' path is incomplete because it omitted A11 and cleanup as a prerequisite.
findings.impact: A literal implementation permits overlapping unfinished attempts and their retained cleanup/resource obligations; an invariant-enforcing implementation deadlocks or diverges from the stated exact sequence.
findings.required_plan_correction: Make successful ordinary reclaim require the old Attempt's effects and cleanup to settle and A11 to commit before successor admission, or redefine the finished/uniqueness contract with a safe separate carrier and prove that it cannot overlap authority. Align PLAN §13, A10/A11, and admission guards explicitly.

findings.title: A retained-risk cleanup disposition may terminalize its parent, but its mandatory resurface path cannot reopen that parent
findings.requirement: A revocable or review-due cleanup disposition must have a legal, deterministic parent projection when it resurfaces; terminal work cannot silently hide newly live cleanup risk.
evidence: docs/state-transition-manifests.md C09 makes CleanupItem ESCALATED_DISPOSITION, which is declared terminal and is terminal-equivalent for eligible FAILED or CANCELLED work.
The same §13 says a resurface trigger, revocation, or review due takes C11 to RETRY_WAIT and 'returns the parent to CLEANING'.
The canonical graph has CLEANING->FAILED and CLEANING->CANCELLED, but no FAILED->CLEANING or CANCELLED->CLEANING edge. Built-in and aggregate terminal states likewise have no reopening event.

Reducer priority 11 can map a reopened improvement cleanup coordinate to CLEANING, but after an improvement tuple has canonically terminalized this would still require an unlisted FAILED|CANCELLED->CLEANING canonical edge.
reproduction: Let cleanup fail, follow C07 and C09, and use the eligible disposition to terminalize the parent as FAILED or CANCELLED.
Trigger the disposition's review_due_at, revocation, or resurface condition. C11 makes the CleanupItem nonterminal RETRY_WAIT.

The contract requires the parent to return to CLEANING, but no legal canonical or parent-aggregate transition exists from its terminal state. Leaving it terminal contradicts the clean/settled terminal predicate because required cleanup is live again.
findings.impact: Retained resources or data can require remediation after the parent is terminal, while the status model either rejects the required reopening event or reports a terminal item whose cleanup is no longer settled.
findings.required_plan_correction: Choose and specify one legal design: keep the parent nonterminal CLEANING for the lifetime of revocable dispositions; add an explicit non-work remediation aggregate whose status remains visible without reopening immutable work; or add fully enumerated reopening transitions and revise terminal semantics. Align C09/C11, canonical edges, all parent aggregates, and the improvement reducer.

residual_uncertainty: This is a plan-text and deterministic local-structure audit, not implementation validation or full model checking.
Fresh immutable retrieval and same-run human semantic review remain future blocking gates and were not treated as closure failures.
